text.tspan: Depressive symptoms across the US population
Respondents were asked about how frequently they had these symptoms in the previous two weeks.
Data source: Tomitaka et al. (2018). Distributional patterns of item responses and total scores on the PHQ-9 in the general population: data from the National Health
